newsitem.title: USA: UNIFI Communications completes $175 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: UNIFI Communications completes $175 mln offering.

text.p: UNIFI Communications Inc said on Monday it had completed its first public financing by issuing $175 million in high-yield debt securities.

UNIFI Communications, a privately owned company that provides enhanced facsimile transmission and delivery services, said it intends to use the net proceeds from its debt offering to finance the expansion of its Intelligent Delivery Network to include 47 new network nodes in 27 countries, among other purposes.
The offering was made through Smith Barney Inc, the company said in a statement.

It added that it has agreed to file an exchange offer registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission within 60 days from the date of original issuance, after which bondholders will be permitted to exchange their originally issued bonds for identical, publicly registered bonds.
